events.description: The Chief of the Counterterrorist Center issues DCI talking points on operations against Usama Bin Ladin. They cover his financial support for the Taleban and the aim of obtaining real-time information on his activities and travels in Afghanistan. The OCR renders the year as 1991, but the document metadata gives 1997.

relationships.detail: Memo states Bin Ladin is spending large sums on support for the Taleban (the Taleban are the recipient; direction is from Bin Ladin as provider).

The memo concerns operations to obtain real-time information on Bin Ladin's activities and travels in Afghanistan.
